name: Lisvel
desc: Lisvel with her ash longbow level across her body, a flat glass visor band and a gull-feather quiver at the hip.

name: Gorgewalk Longbow
desc: Slate-grey limbs bound with rigid gorge-rope and an iron-pinned quiver, as carried by the keepers of the Needlespan gorge.

name: Almanac Longbow
desc: Parchment-printed limbs and ink fletching from the season almanac. The arrows are fletched with rigid page-cut plates.
